🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, a Sector Strength reading; Consumer Discretionary and Industrials are positive, alongside Financials, providing confirmation beyond breadth. Leadership: moderately concentrated across 3 sectors—not narrow by the ≤2-sector definition, but not broad across ≥4 sectors; style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads the sector averages (1W: +3.45%); GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%) are ABOVE TREND. Healthcare (1W: +2.26%) is led by LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), both ABOVE TREND; Materials is also strong (1W: +2.88%), though constituent-level SP100 leaders were not provided.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is the clear laggard (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -6.51%), with GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND. Communication is nearly flat on the week (+0.04%) and negative over the month (-1.22%); Industrials are positive overall (+1.65%) but internally mixed, with CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) and BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5 SP100 names: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%) and UPS (1W: +7.11% | 1M: +15.29%)—all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: moderately concentrated (3 sectors represented), with strength spanning consumer discretionary, healthcare and industrials.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Weakest SP100 names include INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%), BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) and CRM (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -3.18%), all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum among the SP100 names shown: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), all ABOVE TREND. TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION, signaling short-term divergence rather than confirmed trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak, with the sector down 4.05% on the week and 6.51% over the month; GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) and META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) are BELOW TREND. AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION; constituent-level positive breadth was not supplied.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are positive on average (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +4.15%), but individual leadership is mixed: JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%) and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are ABOVE TREND. Sector-level positive performance supports the RISK-ON backdrop, though the supplied data does not establish constituent breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is strong on the sector average (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +10.22%); LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), JNJ (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +5.62%) and PFE (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +8.53%) are ABOVE TREND. UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION, a notable divergence within the sector.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor diversified exposure to the positive sector backdrop while monitoring technology weakness; avoid treating the RISK-ON label as confirmation of broad leadership. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; relative strength is evident in GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), while GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) remain BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), both ABOVE TREND; watch for follow-through after strong weekly gains. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), both BELOW TREND; risk remains elevated unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +3.45%) and Healthcare (1W: +2.26%), with Healthcare also positive over the month (+10.22%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -6.51%); monitor whether weakness broadens beyond the sector’s negative average.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so monitor relative-performance triggers: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) for continuation above their recent trend, and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) for signs of stabilization. AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) remain CORRECTION setups; watch for weekly momentum to turn positive.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+78): raised full-year guidance after a quarterly beat; GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. GM (+75): buyback-related optimism is partly offset by a separate privacy-settlement headline; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) is ABOVE TREND, so price action remains strong despite mixed news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-45): analyst concern over cash flow reset; BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) is BELOW TREND, confirming the negative tone. GM also has a negative privacy-settlement headline (-40), but GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) remains ABOVE TREND, a sentiment-price divergence to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, with 10/11 sectors positive and Sector Strength; leadership spans three sectors, while style is mixed / no clear leadership. GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) are ABOVE TREND, while GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) remains BELOW TREND. Monitor technology weakness and the mixed GM news flow: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) is still ABOVE TREND despite its negative settlement headline.
